notes.title: Steam Deck Installation
notes.content:
- For Steam Deck user follow the instructions to Launch Game.
1. Go to "Settings" for the game
2. Go to "Properties"
3. Go to "Compatibility"
4. Toggle on the "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool"
5. Game should now launch and be fully playable.
